Visit note | 2025-04-24 03:30 PM | Dr. Asif Mahmud, Dermatology | Patient: Riad Ahmed, 32, male. Mr. Ahmed consults because he has experienced intermittent swelling of his lips and related skin reactions. He notes that the condition began after taking a new painkiller bought in Chattogram. He works as a shopkeeper in Dhaka and has Hypothyroidism. He denies any recent travel abroad, insect stings, or breathing difficulty.
